summary: Iteration 70 verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 PASS, 1 skipped (no related_chat_id on probed project for direct checkout test — covered separately via the UI run). New codegen produces all 7 required files; index.html has login-view + app-view, email/password inputs, Sign in button and the demo@example.com hint; app.js references localStorage + demo creds; backend/server.py exposes /api/auth/login, a Pydantic login model (LoginReq or OAuth2PasswordRequestForm depending on LLM variance), and CORSMiddleware. talk-to-build works with and without role_key. role-claims GET/POST/DELETE still work. @devmgr auto-start (≥40 char body) drops the new 'working' + 'demo@example.com / demo' system message — no 'static design mockup' wording anywhere. Frontend: MockupNotice copy updated to 'Working preview · sign in with the demo credentials'; collapsed strip says 'Working preview' and references demo@example.com / demo; collapse persists across reload via safeStorage. Hire Dev Team toolbar button (data-testid=hire-dev-team-toolbar) is visible when project.related_chat_id is set and clicking it triggers POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/hire-dev-team/checkout (confirmed via network log). End-to-end iframe login works: typing demo@example.com / demo + clicking Sign in swaps to the app view with a Sign Out button (Expense Tracker dashboard visible); clicking Sign Out returns to the login view.
critical_code_review_comments: services/dev_os_codegen.py — LLM prompt for backend/server.py says 'Use Pydantic v2 models' but doesn't lock the model name; one observed LLM run produced OAuth2PasswordRequestForm form-data login instead of a JSON {email,password} body. Functionally OK (still has /api/auth/login + CORS + a Pydantic Token model) but it drifts from the in-browser SPA which POSTs JSON — when the user swaps localStorage for fetch(), the contract won't match. Consider adding 'Body MUST be JSON {email, password} via a Pydantic model named LoginReq' to make it stricter.

services/dev_chat_agents.py:_maybe_auto_start_project — the ≥40 char check happens AFTER stripping mentions, so a request like '@devmgr build me an expense tracker' (27 chars stripped) silently no-ops. Friendlier UX would be to either lower the threshold or have devmgr reply with 'tell me a bit more about what you want to build'.
test_credentials: amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 via POST /api/auth/demo-login (sets tn_session cookie). Demo creds inside the generated SPA: demo@example.com / demo.
seed_data_creation: TestAutoStartCopy creates a 'TEST_iter70_autostart' group chat and its associated auto-generated dev_project. Demo workspace data is documented to reset hourly, so no manual cleanup necessary.

The @devmgr auto-start test MUST send a body that's ≥40 chars after @-mentions are stripped — use the test's `trigger_body` constant as a template.
